issues_confirmed: models/linear_regression.py:10-15 - logging.basicConfig(filename='test/LinearReg_debug.log') runs at import time; test/ does not exist, so `import models` raises FileNotFoundError. models/__init__.py:4 imports this module, so every model is unimportable. Reproduced from the repo root.

.gitignore:27 - test/ is gitignored. `git ls-files` returns zero test files and the directory is absent from disk, yet Makefile:21-25 invokes five test scripts. `make test`, the command README.md:57 documents, cannot succeed for anyone.

ml_math/CPP_vector.py:40-55 - matrix_vector_multiply sizes vec_arr from len(vec) but vector_math.cpp:25 loops j < cols where cols = len(matrix[0]); when len(vec) < cols the C++ reads past the end of the ctypes buffer. Observed matrix_vector_multiply([[0,0,1],[0,0,2]], [0.0]) returning [8.3214395e-317, 1.6642879e-316], varying per call. Reachable via LinearRegression.predict / LogisticRegression.predict, neither of which checks X's column count against len(self.weights).

ml_math/CPP_vector.py:18-31 and :57-64 - dot, add and euclidean_distance set size = len(a) and build the b buffer as (c_double * size)(*b), silently zero-padding a shorter b. euclidean_distance([3,4,99],[0,0]) returns 99.126. KNN._predict_single (models/knn.py:31) therefore answers a 3-D query against 2-D training data with a confident label and no error (distances [15.588, 9.11], label 1). A longer b instead raises a bare 'IndexError: invalid index' from inside ctypes.

ml_math/utils.py:8 - sigmoid uses 1/(1+math.exp(-x)) and raises OverflowError for x <= about -710 (sigmoid(-700) = 9.86e-305, sigmoid(-710) throws). Reachable from LogisticRegression.fit at logistic_regression.py:26 with unscaled features.

models/linear_regression.py:25-29 - the TypeError fallback is dead code. For 1-D X it prints a recovery message and sets n_features = 1, then crashes at :41 anyway because matrix_vector_multiply also calls len(matrix[0]). Verified: prints the message, then 'TypeError: object of type float has no len()'.
models/linear_regression.py:38 and :45-47 - three logging.debug calls inside the per-sample loop, so a 1000-epoch fit over 1000 samples emits over 3M eagerly-formatted records.

reference.md (previous revision) lines 39-47 claimed a passing `make test` run listing test_linear_reg.py results, but the Makefile never invokes that script and no test files are tracked; the same file said '6 test scripts' at line 36 and 'all 5' at line 42.
cpp/libvector.so is tracked in git - an architecture-specific compiled binary committed alongside its source, with no signal when the two diverge.
